## Volume 01 Closed — Guardrails still binding in Volume 02

- **Volume 01 ended at Chapter 48 with the notice `Permission: find the blank bearer.` on the Old Ward board. Volume 02 has not restated, answered or explained it, and must not open a chapter by reissuing it as a system message.**
- The volume's calendar is anchored at Chapter 21 = Thursday 13 March and was never recomputed from the real calendar. **19 May is a Monday. 20 May is a Tuesday. 26 May is a Monday. 29 May is a Thursday. 18 July is a Friday. Do not recompute.**
- Standing dates ahead of Chapter 70: the **west-clinic 22:00 handovers continue daily and are short**; the **19 May sitting is over and Schedule 4 is referred on to the next sitting, whose date the Committee has not fixed**; **Royden Achebe's 6-L/14 report is due Thursday 29 May**; the **claims box closes Friday 18 July**; Jonas is on nothing.
- Keep the west-clinic gate running on its local term. It **cannot** be renewed by Jonas, the department or a manager.
- The 11:00–13:30 gap, Bram Osei's unfilled Thursday and the two-refusal rule all stay open and dated. **The retainer is paid; the damage was a witness, and the first hollow term was written by another one.**
- **The Weir stand has no term, no holder and no claim, and the trap can no longer be cleared by anybody.** Nobody may add a name to that rota. Bo Trimble is findable and nothing may be added to him. The bank line has a ring round a blank space and may not be filled by a speech. **Margo Doré has said out loud that she wants the street left with nothing on it, and a pump has not been offered yet.**
- Lorna Vessey's released slot, Marta Sowle's fall, Ruth Nwosu's unrecorded hours, the nine minutes of 24 March, the nineteen of 3 April and the forty minutes of 15 April are all on the public box and none is discharged. **The forty minutes is time until the family knew, not the time the door took. There is no 48-minute figure in this account and no later volume may print one.**
- **Do not open Selah Mora's sealed log, copy resident identities, or put the Weir's tin or the market's brass tag into a file.**
- **Do not explain the Quiet Cut, the civic erasure, the watch term's origin, Evan, or Iona. Do not read a root clause. Volume 02 contains no root reading, no root clause and no succession.**
- Do not resolve the Weir's three-way disagreement, the burnt letter, the boy of nineteen, or the name in biro on the map, and do not let Jonas choose for the Weir.
- **Keep System language sparing: at most one short notice per ordinary chapter, on a civic maintenance surface, never choosing the solution, never naming a person.** The ceiling was exceeded once in Ch 46 and logged. **Volume 02 Chapters 49–59 used five notices across eleven chapters and exceeded it in none.**
- **No death, no rescue by chance.** Six bottles were carried up a hundred and nine steps by a woman of sixty-one who is not on any rota at ten to five in the morning, and nobody wrote it down, and if anybody had she would have asked them to take it out.

## Volume 02 — Open questions the next batch must carry

**Chapters 71–80. The heat, the narrowings, the first transfer that has to be repeated, and a cooperative steward board that does not exist yet.**

1. **The heat.** A **Borough Heat Threshold Protocol** is pinned to the Old Ward board: activation on three consecutive days at 27°C or above, requiring residential care premises to **confirm occupancy and a named responsible person for every address in their custody.** It was twenty-nine on 19 May and the next four days are forecast at thirty, thirty-one, twenty-nine and twenty-eight. **That is Schedule 4's logic arriving as health and safety, and it asks a landlord to produce in a form the thing Marguerite Oyelaran spent a month refusing to let a form produce.** Four hundred and twenty women in this borough have their instruments out of one decontamination room on level zero, whose supplier's service contract now runs on £410 and twenty minutes a week that nobody has taken. Spring tides: 21, 22, 28, 29 May and 1 June.
2. **06:00 Sunday 12 October 2014**, when the Saint Orra west schedule expires, and **the 22:00 handover on Saturday the eleventh of October is the crossing**: a six-day term read then begins at 07:00 on the twelfth, one hour after the money stops, and two tired porters will read it and will not know. **Tomas Renn is going to ask the two-refusal question with that date on it, in the shop on Monday 19 May and then in a corridor at Saint Orra west on Thursday 22 May, and Jonas has been told twice not to come.**
3. **The first transfer that has to be repeated.** Jonas's name is on the 17 May record as the man who moved it. Achebe cannot hand the claim back. In August somebody will ring him about a Tuesday, and **legal responsibility follows the transfer and not the person who received it**, and he learns that the difference is the whole of transfer stewardship and it is not a gift.
4. **Royden Achebe's 6-L/14 report is due 29 May** and the bank is gone and the trap is lost and the burden is his, and it will land in the same week as the heat.
5. **The September record the chair has promised**, in which a number of nodes in this city have **no party answering for them**, is owed and not yet written, and there is a form with a hole in it and a word *nobody* in Nina Calder's hand.
6. **Margo Doré, who has not been told that a Tier 1 price on six lowland water points is in a public record in the Old Ward**, and who has said she wants the street left with nothing on it. This is live and unpaid.
7. **The Borough Heat Threshold Protocol and the return both ask the same question — who is the named responsible person for an address — and **the one body in this city that can answer it for a hundred and twenty-eight rooms has spent a month refusing to let anybody ask it of her.**
8. **The cooperative steward board**, which does not exist yet, was named and refused in one sentence in the 19 May transcript and **may not be formed in this batch.**

## Standing guardrails for Chapters 71–80

- **One Lattice notice per ordinary chapter at most.** Four were used in Chapters 60–70, in Chapters 61, 65, 68 and 70. The Ch 46 ceiling was not repeated and is not to be.
- **No death, no rescue by chance, no lucky timing.** Nobody is saved by luck in this batch either.
- **Do not tidy the Weir, the annex, the retainer, the two-refusal question, the burnt letter, the boy of nineteen, the map's margin, or the blank line on the form.** **Do not resolve the Weir's three-way disagreement and do not let Jonas choose it. A pump may be offered; Margo Doré may refuse it in her own words; it may not be argued out of her.**
- **Keep the west-clinic gate running on its local term. It cannot be renewed by Jonas, the department, or a manager.** The rota has still not been built again, the terms are still six days, the 11:00–13:30 gap is still published and unfilled, and **Bram Osei's refused Thursday is still on the board and he asked that it stay, and Priya Ranganathan has said she is not going to be the person who asks him for a second refusal on a Sunday so that there are two of them on a board.**
- **The forty minutes of 15 April is time until the family knew, not the time the door took, and no 48-minute figure may ever be printed.**
- **The claims box closes Friday 18 July and nothing may be written into it that establishes a service or a person.**
- **A node with no term in force is not a person with no address. Do not slide from one into the other.** A duty is an act and not a place, and that is the instrument, and it is not a recognition of a street or of its people.
- **The cooperative steward board is the end of the volume, not a device of the next batch. It may be named, argued about, or refused. It may not be formed here.**
- **The register of attachment is a bucket under a tap and it is now on a record in a file as the name of the man who moved a duty. He may not be appointed, made acting, shadowed, or released by no person.**

**TOMAS RENN'S QUESTION ABOUT THE DAY AFTER IS UNANSWERED AND IS THE SERIES' CURRENT LIVE QUESTION.** *What happens on the day after, when she is in the field again because she has to be, and a consent can be given twice — which is not defeating the clause, it is complying with it, twice.* **On 24 September 2014 Yolanda Fofana declined to answer it, gave the reason, and told Jonas Mercer not to write it down. He did not write it down. He wrote down that he was told not to write it down. Nobody argued with her. This is a standing refusal and may not be argued out of her, and the reason she gave is Volume 03's door.**

**SATURDAY 11 OCTOBER 2014, 22:00 — twelve days after the volume closes, and the volume's last image, and it was never staged.** A six-day term read then begins at 07:00 on Sunday 12 October, one hour after the money stops. Four people could read that term, all four have given a correct answer, none has given an answer, and there is no rule for two of them. **Jonas Mercer and Tomas Renn will not discuss it, and that rule between them is the only instrument either of them produced in the year that is any use at all. It may be named on a wall, in a minute or on a list, by anybody. It may not be staged again and it may not be resolved in Volume 03 by anybody who was not in that corridor.**

## 2. What Volume 02 won, and what it did not

- **Priority access is invalid in a published determination where it was bought with a fee and by nothing else.** One sentence, one page, a sub-substitution of Schedule 4, limited to precedence, with the class of node named and no consequence provided for.
- **NOTHING WAS DISSOLVED. CivicCore keeps the physical network**, the hinges, the floor at Gantry Ward and every contract. It loses the thing it was selling. **The cost of the narrowness is Rook's, delivered in a doorway: a thing that was going to happen anyway now has to be argued for, in public, repeatedly, by people who are not paid to argue, and a clause that cannot be challenged by a person cannot require them to.**
- **A cooperative steward board exists.** Nine seats. Eight filled by people already doing a thing and asked nothing; one filled in a hall by a woman in an apron who stated her price out loud and did not hide a word of it. **It has no money, no chair, one power and no way to lose it, and the ninth of them is a person.**
- **A reading rule**, the Committee's first act in four months that was not a form: where a party relies on either of the two entries for Meter Room 3, the other is to be read with it. **The two entries still stand and still cannot be amended and the Committee was not misled; it was read to, twice.**
- **A record of shapes with no name box on it, by decision and not by oversight**, and the blank line at the bottom of the register of narrowings is still blank and the register has not grown since 4 August and is now a record of a period.

## 3. The new standing instruments, and they are all still unpaid

- **THE FOURTH PAGE** — one week, one place, one number, what was counted, one sentence saying what it is not, no index, no name box, nothing may be added, **and a person may refuse to be counted and the count then says so and says how many refused.** On a public board. Nobody has asked Nina Calder what it is for and she has not said.
- **NO FIFTH PAGE WAS WRITTEN AND SHE REFUSED IN A PUBLIC ROOM AT A COUNTER ON 1 SEPTEMBER**, in the right order, unargued: *the fifth page is the form, the form is a scheme, a scheme is a list with a future in it, and a form is the last thing a person writes and the first thing an institution keeps.* Standing refusal. Nobody may come back to it.
- **A YEAR ON A PIECE OF PAPER IN A POST BOX** — one letter, 1938, thirty rooms, a stopcock that turns, a tag, four meters, one name at the bottom, no household in it at all, and the wrongness named: it is written by a man who is not authorised to write it for a woman who has not been asked what she wants in it.
- **A CONDITION THAT A CONSENT MAY BE GIVEN TWICE** and that the record of the second is not evidence about the first, printed on an enamel strip in a corridor, unsigned, undated and unattributed.
- **A CONDITION THAT A BODY WHICH CANNOT BE REQUIRED TO DO ANYTHING CANNOT BE ASKED WHAT IT WILL DO**, printed on a card beside the register of narrowings, initialled by a records supervisor because a condition nobody has claimed can be put in an edition.

## 4. The new bodies, and the old ones, and the cost of each

- **Nine seats: eight named people and one woman.** Y. Amoah, 41, ambulance duty officer, eleven years. I. Sesay, 51, caretaker, Tarn Street school. D. Fahey, facilities supervisor, Saint Orra west, six years. I. Tarrant, car park supervisor, eleven years. S. Umeh, 58, market porter and lock-up keeper, thirty years. K. Ferris, 33, night bus controller, nine years. W. Crabbe, 62, linen supervisor, nineteen years. G. Nye, 44, self-employed heating engineer, twenty-one years. **And Y. Fofana, 54, named steward of Wren Court, findable at an address, unpaid, the only seat in the body that cannot be emptied by anybody else and therefore the only seat that can empty it, and she does not know that, and is not going to be told, because a person may not be required even to be told.**

## 5. Forbidden in Volume 03 and in everything after it, in addition to everything already forbidden

# VOLUME 03 OPEN THREADS — as they stand after Chapter 110, Wednesday 3 December 2014

**Read with the "VOLUME 03, BATCH 0001" block at the end of `state/continuity.md`, which carries the canon. This file carries only what is still open and what it is forbidden to do.**

## 1. The nine people and two chairs

- **SEVEN OF NINE. The seventh chair has been empty since Wednesday 8 October 2014, when Kathleen Ferris, 33, night bus controller, wrote four lines on the back of a bus timetable and gave them to the woman who keeps the minutes. Nobody has read them out and nobody may.** The board could not fill it, because a body that cannot require anybody cannot require one of its own, and because six weeks of working out who to want instead is a rota.
- **The eighth chair has been empty since the evening of Wednesday 26 November 2014**, when Stanley Umeh, 58, market porter and lock-up keeper, stood up and said *Right. I'm going* and nobody argued and nobody asked him a second question. **He answered for the shutter and the padlock and what the padlock is for, and the minute records the seat as a lock-up and not as a district or a facility, and the box in the form is left empty on purpose and the minute says so.** A shape where a person was, and the shape is the only interesting thing on the page.
- **Nobody can fill either and nobody can unfill either and there is no power in this city that could.** The body does not dissolve; a dissolution needs six.
- **Four of the nine have said they will stop if it turns into a job.** Gloria Nye said it in eleven words on 8 October and apologised and has not withdrawn it. Ines Tarrant said she meant it and has not stopped and asked to be asked why and nobody was able to ask her. The ninth seat said it in about nine seconds in a records office in September and gave the arithmetic.
- **The ninth seat is a woman of fifty-four who is findable at a shopfront, unpaid, doing it for nothing since 4 July, who has said she will not be paid until she is sixty-one and that after that she will not be, and who is the only door in a building of thirty-one rented rooms.** **Nobody on that board knows that the ninth seat is the only seat that cannot be emptied by anybody else, and therefore the only seat that can empty the body, and she has said out loud twice that she will not be told, and she is right.** Three people know: a clerk who copied it out by hand, a registrar who read it twice, and a records supervisor who read it once and told nobody and gave a reason in a public room. **Do not resolve it. Do not have the board notice it. Do not have anybody tell her.**
- **Page four of section 11 is a dissolution clause at six vacancies, read by three people and told to nobody. Nobody has come near acting on it and nobody may.**

## 2. The letter, and the thing it cost

- **It worked. The four meters are not going into the Block C cupboard; they went to a block of 1974. The freeholder's standing instruction of 14 April was withdrawn. A condition survey of the riser space and the roof void is coming in the spring, on a sheet of A4 in a plastic wallet, and it says *feasibility*, and feasibility has never once in this city produced a restored anything.**
- **Nobody is entitled to know what the managing agent's clerk said and the batch did not find out and Volume 03 must not.**
- **One of the two survey nodes went into the register of narrowings on 14 November and the other did not, and there is nobody anybody is entitled to ask which of them is correct.**
- **IVY MARSDEN, 72, was told on Thursday 13 November by the man who wrote the letter, at her own door, in daylight, with nine minutes' notice, and she refused a copy, and she worked out what the letter was for in about four minutes, and she told him the price of it: the day a piece of paper says the buckets are the block's, the block is a thing that can be asked, and a thing that can be asked is a thing that has a landlord, and a thing that has a landlord is a thing that has a list.** She is no more findable and a great deal more frightened. She let him write down that his name is now in a thing in her head that has to do with her. **Nobody goes up those stairs again.**
- **The two conditions on the Old Ward board stay unreconciled: the city's own paper, printed 14/8, initialled N.C., and sixteen inches below it an enamel strip, unsigned, undated, unattributed, with two initials and one word in pencil on the back of it and the word is *not mine*. The initials are not a signature to the condition and the writer of any batch must never decide in prose whose they are.**

## 3. The two records, and the reading rule

- **Record one, September: a record of shapes, a number, sixteen, no name box by decision.** It cannot be wrong, therefore it could not be found wrong, and that is why it was a photograph.
- **Record two, published the third week of November: FIFTY-ONE NODES on the continuity schedule as at 18:00 on Monday 6 October 2014, THIRTY-EIGHT PARTIES, THIRTEEN SHAPES, checkable at a counter by anybody, for nothing, by post, as of a date. It went out UNSIGNED, with no name box, and about four hundred people have added their names to it.** It establishes nothing and it can be argued with and being arguable is the point.
- **Nobody is required to be told they are in it, and that is the design and not an oversight, and it was said in the room where it was agreed and it may not be softened.**
- **The difference between the two records is FOUR, and Calder can say what three of them are and will not say the fourth, and Jonas Mercer read three and refused the fourth in a room with three people in it, and neither of them will ever write it down.**
- **The fourth of the four is a meter room a person could walk to, and it can be walked to, and the woman who wrote the page thought about that in a corridor on 19 November with her coat on. Unresolved and the most dangerous sentence anybody has produced this year.**
- **The reading rule of 21 August has left the only room it was made in, once, in one copy, on foot, in a woman's inside pocket. It is an act and not a document: a person reading two sentences out loud to another person in a room with the second person able to say no. It cannot be put in a form, a job description, a rota, an establishment or an edition, because any of those turns it into a service. A managing agent has refused a copy of it for a correct reason and the reason may not be argued with. A clerk has announced that she is going to misuse it in a corridor, on her own time, for a person nobody may be told about, and nobody may ask her whether she has done it.**

## 4. The register, and the shape on the wall

- **NINETEEN entries. Three times in nine weeks, every one of the three correct, and a records supervisor has said the true thing about it: a register that grows when nobody is hurt is a register with a motive in it and a register somebody can hold over you, and if anybody ever uses that board against anybody they will not use the meter room, they will use the bulb.**
- **The blank line at the bottom is blank and stays blank and is now the only fixed point in the building.** It was blank on 1 December and it is expected to be blank on 4 January.
- **A form with no name box on it has been used to find a building twice, by careful people doing exactly what it was designed to do, and there is nobody in the whole of this to blame except a man with a register who asked for a state and got one.** A design is not a promise.

## 5. The six words, and the two men they connect

- **`6-L/14. NON-CIVIC PLANT.` Said out loud twice in rooms: one word on 28 October to about eleven people, and nineteen seconds on 21 November to about ten people, including the name of the man who lodged it and did not read it. Both minutes are public and neither contains his name, because there is no box for one.**
- **PETER NAYLOR, 44, level-three acceptance officer, field services, Gantry Ward, out of estates since 2011: signed an acceptance in about ninety seconds in August, does not know what any of the words mean, has a fortnight somewhere in this city with a bucket under a tap, and NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH IS ABLE TO ASK HIM ONE QUESTION ABOUT ANY OF IT. Two people told Jonas Mercer not to and he has not. His name and the six words are now connectable in a public record and he has not been told and cannot be told.**
- **ROYDEN ACHEBE, 49, NDC field services manager: named publicly for the first time on 21 November, in a minuted room, in a sentence about what he did and did not read before lodging a classification on 22 March. He was not in the room, he has not been told, he could be asked about it tomorrow morning, and nobody has asked him. He is NOT the man of forty-four and the two must never be conflated in prose.** He telephoned the shop on 14 August about a Tuesday and Jonas Mercer was the one who answered, and Jonas Mercer has never rung him since either.
- **The six words took four tonnes of stone and about £1,180 off anybody's schedule and put them on nobody's invoice, and they took a lowland piece of ground out of the review, and the street is still on it because the other half of that morning was voted down, and no document anywhere says how the two halves are related.**

## 6. The lowland, and the six shapes

- **The lowland is not on the layer. The layer draws nine service districts, eight named, the ninth not drawn. So the lowland is not in the board's eight districts, so there is no seat for it, and there is no instrument in this city by which there could be one, and the reason is not an oversight and may not be fixed in Volume 03.**
- **Six water points at Tier 1, £1,880 a year, £11,280, in paragraph 6.1 of the minute of 19 May, recorded as received and not as evidence, and nobody has been asked for any part of it, and the chair said in the margin in the clerk's hand: *I will not require a person at six water points. Noted. The reason nobody has asked is the reason this Committee cannot answer.***
- **Six shapes were identified in discussion in a hall on 28 October and are named in no document. One of them is a green pillar with a bucket on a chain and a forty-slot board at the top of a three-hundred-metre street with a canal on one side and boat sheds on the other, whose trap is gone and whose bank is gone, and the ninth seat named it and would not say where it is. The Weir's three positions stand on a kitchen wall with a name against each and a fourth line has a ring of pencil round a blank space. Margo Doré's advance refusal of a pump is unargued, no pump was offered, and none exists. Jonas Mercer did not go up the path in this batch.**
- **The Weir, the annex, the retainer, the two-refusal question and the day after, the burnt letter, the boy of nineteen, the map's margin, Dev Singh's empty-crossing clause and the Selah Mora log are all unresolved and all forbidden to resolve.**

## 7. The midpoint, and what it cost

- **A letter went through the door of a Methodist hall on Friday 28 November 2014, addressed to a cooperative steward board, care of a hall, because a published minute says where they sit. One side of A4, biro, no crest, no form number, no reference, no date in a box, in a hand that is not a clerk's. It is signed.**
- **Its author is BERNICE OFORI, 34, who has been at a stand at the bottom of Quarry Street at twenty to seven every morning with a folding trolley, and who has kept to a date on that stand with no person on it for eleven years, and who gave no name to anybody in this account until 3 December.** She asked whether the stand is one of the six. She asked for nothing. She signed it on purpose, because a room is not a record, and she said so twice.
- **On Wednesday 3 December at 18:41 a man said her name out loud in a room with about eleven people in it. He did not write it down. Nobody asked him a second question and nobody asked whether it was correct. The minute says a name was stated, once, and does not contain it, and records that the letter was not entered in it and that there is no box for one and that this is a decision and not an oversight. The minute went out on Friday 5 December and is a public document and the name is not in it.**
- **THE NAME IS IN ABOUT ELEVEN PEOPLE AND IN NO DOCUMENT. There is no instrument in this borough that can un-say a thing in a room, and there is one that can un-write it, and it is the same instrument they have had since March.**
- **BATCH 0002 MUST NOT: put that name in a form, a minute, a return, a holder field or any document; send anybody to that street; have her rescued, helped, given water, given a seat or given anything; have her thank anybody; or resolve what her standing now is. Findability is not answerability, and a person is not a door because a man said her name once.**

## 8. The winter, and the dates that are not written down

- **The Saint Orra west term expires at 06:00 on SUNDAY 4 JANUARY 2015. The terms are six days. The rota has still not been rebuilt. The 11:00–13:30 gap is still published and still unfilled. Bram Osei's refused Thursday is still on the board in his own words and Priya Ranganathan's card is still on the board because she put it there. The gate runs on its local term and cannot be renewed by Jonas, the department or a manager — only by the people who read it aloud at ten at night.**
- **The handover is on the Saturday night before it, which is Saturday 3 January 2015, and NO DATE HAS BEEN WRITTEN DOWN ANYWHERE FOR THAT SATURDAY NIGHT, because a person is not required to be told and there is nobody in this borough who is required to write it.**
- **The autumn compliance report is out or due with a paragraph number on it for a decontamination verification that was not evidenced for three months, at a hospital with four hundred and twenty women in it. The going-forward verification was weekly and by a named person who is not on a rota, and after October it lapsed, because a man of forty-eight said out loud in a corridor in August that a job in November has a department in it. Nobody has rung him.**
- **A second tray is on a shelf in a building in Gantry Ward with a rubber band and a date in biro and one question outstanding: is there any party who may consent to the works. The answer is no and it has been no since 29 May, and the man who could answer it signed a piece of paper in ninety seconds in August saying *not released* and does not know what any of the words mean.**
- **The claims box is closed and empty. The sealed envelope is in a drawer on a lower floor with one card in it about a stair. Nothing may be written into it and nobody may open it, and a man stood six feet from it in August and did not.**

## 9. The refusals, all ten, none argued out

The mortuary porter's four words in nine seconds · Marguerite Oyelaran's nine seconds and a person-box · Emeka Rusk's, and helping does not go on a form · Margo Doré's advance refusal of a pump · Sanaa Iqbal's twenty minutes a week · Ivo Bamba's, spent in Chapter 90 and not reused · Nina Calder's fifth page · Yolanda Fofana's refusal to answer the day after · **new, and standing: Frances Tolley's, in a corridor, on 26 November** · **new, and standing: Bernice Ofori's, which is the reason the volume has a midpoint.**

**Nobody refuses to be thanked anywhere in Volume 03. Nobody thanks Ivo Bamba or Yvonne Amoah. No minute records that a person has not been thanked, and the ninth seat is not thanked for anything.**

## 10. Still reserved, and forbidden to any batch in this volume

No root reading, no root clause, no succession, no Iona, no Evan, no counter-amendment, no second signature, no Quiet Cut, no origin of the community-watch term, no three-line brass tokens. **Volumes 07, 09 and 15.** **Prue Calloway's location-of-record finding of 23 April — *a building has an address, it is the people who have no location of record, and a panel cannot weigh a claim from a person it cannot locate* — is the Volume 03 door and it has not been opened. It may be opened once, in a room, in daylight, and not resolved.** The forty minutes of 15 April is time until the family knew; **no 48-minute figure may ever be printed.** The forty *hours* of 3 April is the gate being open and is a different number about a different thing. **Nine hundred and forty is a number of times. Fourteen is a difference between two public numbers and is on no instrument. They have never been in the same sentence and must not be, and nine hundred and eighty-six is a number of Wednesdays and must never be in one either.**

## 1. The counter, the shelf, and the drift

- **THE SHELF IS NINE SLIPS IN A DRAWER UNDER THE GROUND-FLOOR COUNTER, ONE HAND, DATED, UNSIGNED, NO REFERENCE, NO BOX, NO NAME ON ANY OF THEM INCLUDING NINA CALDER'S.** Jonas Mercer has seen the edges of them and has not counted, looked, or asked. - **NINE SLIPS AND ABOUT ELEVEN PEOPLE A DAY ARE TWO DIFFERENT NUMBERS AND MUST NEVER BE ADDED TOGETHER.** A slip is only written when a person stands in front of her and asks what was true on a day, and out of nine people a day, and then eleven, the ones who ask that are three men who have all come more than once and one other person about whom nobody has said a word, and that is the whole of them. **A form that added the two would say *this counter sees eleven people and produces one document*, which is a level of service. There is no level of service in that room.** The nine, exactly, are listed in the continuity block. Eight went into three inside pockets; the ninth went out on a Friday afternoon in the last week of February to somebody who was not in a room with anybody.
- **NINA CALDER HAS NEVER GIVEN EITHER NUMBER TO ANYBODY.** In the one answer she gave a stranger about herself on 6 March 2015 she described the drawer and said nothing about how many were in it and nothing about how many people came through the door. **No character in this batch knows either figure. The count of nine is the count of the account and not the count of a person.**
- **The drift, which is this batch's engine and nobody's instrument:** a state given on a Tuesday can be wrong on the Wednesday; a counter that is required to answer and is not required to make one goes on answering the same state for as long as nobody comes back to argue it; there is no obligation in this city to come back; a person turning up is not an instrument, it is a coincidence, and a coincidence every week is a service. **UNRESOLVED AND NOT GOING TO BE RESOLVED. Do not build an instrument for it in Batch 0004.**
- **The interval: 2 February to 13 February is eleven days, and eleven days has no word, and a series has a word for the gap. Somebody is going to work out what eleven days is.**
- **The throughput: about nine PEOPLE a day on 26 January, about eleven on 6 March, on the back of a hand, in no book. A number of nine in a record is a capacity; a capacity is a promise; the day there is a number on that counter there is a morning somebody can say *we can only do eight today* and be entirely correct. This is a count of people and not a count of documents, it is not the nine in the drawer, and the two may never be added together.**
- **NINA CALDER IS ABOUT TO BE PROVED RIGHT ABOUT THE SECOND HALF OF HER OWN SENTENCE — a register that grows when nobody is hurt is a register somebody can hold over you — and it will not be about the bulb. Jonas Mercer has worked out that he is not going to be in the room and has not told her. UNRESOLVED.**
- **The eleventh thing, added on 6 March 2015 and the only thing anybody has added: THE FLOOR CAN BE ASKED ABOUT ITSELF, AND THE ONLY REASON IT CAN BE ASKED ABOUT ITSELF IS THAT THERE IS A PERSON ON IT AND THE PERSON IS NOT FINDABLE. It is not an item, it is in no minute, and nobody may put it on a wall. The five items of 28 January may not be restated as a list in any form.**

## 9. The winter and the dates that are not written down

- **A TERM IS SIX DAYS. IT IS READ AT 22:00 ON THE SATURDAY NIGHT BEFORE THE SUNDAY IT STARTS ON, AND THE GATE OPENS AT 07:00 ON THAT SUNDAY, AND THE TERM EXPIRES AT 06:00 ON THE FOLLOWING SUNDAY. THE SATURDAY NIGHTS ARE WHAT ARE A WEEK APART. NEVER CALL THE TERM SEVEN DAYS AND NEVER CALL IT A WEEK.** The chain is: 24 Jan, 31 Jan, 7, 14, 21, 28 Feb, 7 and 14 March 2015, all at 22:00, and **there is no date written down anywhere in this city for a single one of them and there is not going to be one, because a person is not required to be told and there is nobody in this borough who is required to write it.**
- **WHO READ THEM ALOUD, on every one since 3 January 2015: EZRA MBEKI, in and out of that building since 1992, and TREVOR NUNN, 58, a night porter, nineteen years, who is not on a roster because the roster does not exist. Neither is on any instrument. Neither knew until about nine o'clock. It took about nine minutes and then they sat down and went home at about half past six. JONAS MERCER HAS NEVER BEEN TOLD THAT ANY OF THEM OCCURRED, HAS NEVER ASKED, AND IS NOT GOING TO ASK.**
- **HE WAS IN THAT CORRIDOR ONCE, AT HALF PAST FOUR IN THE MORNING ON SUNDAY 4 JANUARY 2015, AND THE GATE HAS NEVER ONCE BEEN OPENED BY ANYTHING HE DID IN IT. He did not go on 1 February and DID NOT DECIDE NOT TO GO, and that silence is the whole of why he could then refuse the next one out loud: A FOURTH IS A HABIT AND A HABIT IS A ROTA WITH ONE NAME IN IT. It cost nothing and it is the only thing in the batch he got right by not doing it.**
- **THE NEXT ONE IS SATURDAY 14 MARCH 2015 AT TEN O'CLOCK AT NIGHT, THE EIGHTH OF THEM IN SEVEN WEEKS, AND THERE IS NO DATE ON IT AND NO FORM ON WHICH ANYBODY COULD RECORD THAT IT HAPPENED.**
- The 11:00–13:30 row is still empty and still does not say *vacant*. Bram Osei's Thursday is still refused in his own handwriting with *no reason I can give* under a *no reason given* in somebody else's hand, and nobody has looked at it. Priya Ranganathan's card is still on the Friday and Saturday rows because she put it there. **The rota has still not been rebuilt and cannot be.**
- A counter in this borough was asked nothing about the gate by anybody else and looked for nothing about the gate, and the reason given out loud is that a counter with an opinion about a gate is a service. **NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH MAY LET THAT COUNTER ANSWER ANYTHING ABOUT A GATE, OR ABOUT A ROTA, OR ABOUT A COMPLIANCE PARAGRAPH, OR ABOUT A PERSON. A COUNTER THAT ANSWERS ABOUT ANY OF THOSE IS A SERVICE.** The claims box is closed and empty. The sealed envelope is in a drawer on a lower floor and may not be opened or written into.

- **NINA CALDER REFUSED OUT LOUD, UNASKED, TO SAY WHICH ONE IS OPERATIVE, and gave the reason, and the reason is the same reason Jonas Mercer gave in a room on 28 January about a page of a regulation from 2008: `if you ask me on the second of June I shall tell you the same thing in the same words.` She would rather stand under a contradiction for another four years than be the woman who settled it. UNRESOLVED. THE MOST DANGEROUS SENTENCE ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH COULD HAVE SAID IN FEBRUARY WAS *THAT IS THE RULES*, NOBODY SAID IT, AND ONE OF THE TWO WOULD HAVE BEEN RIGHT IF THEY HAD.**
- **The batch's finding on that wall, and it is physical: a person walking under two conditions that do not agree goes faster. A contradiction is not a pause, it is a floor that is not level, and everybody crosses a floor that is not level faster than a floor that is. And the corollary: THE FLOOR OF A SERVICE IS A PLACE WHERE A PERSON CAN STAND UNDER A CONTRADICTION AND BE ANSWERED. It is eleven feet by nine and it is not going on a wall.**

No root reading, no root clause, no succession, no Iona, no Evan, no counter-amendment, no second signature, no Quiet Cut, no origin of the community-watch term, no three-line brass tokens. **Volumes 07, 09 and 15.** **Prue Calloway's location-of-record finding of 23 April was OPENED ONCE, IN A ROOM, IN DAYLIGHT, ON 28 JANUARY 2015, AND IT IS NOT RESOLVED, AND IT MAY NOT BE OPENED A SECOND TIME; what may be argued afterwards is its consequence, and nobody in this borough has been made to live under the consequence yet and nobody is going to be. The claim to open a door in this volume is spent.** The forty minutes of 15 April is time until the family knew; **no 48-minute figure may ever be printed; the forty *hours* of 3 April is the gate being open and is a different number about a different thing; and no other figure of minutes exists anywhere in this borough.** Nine hundred and forty is a number of times, nine hundred and eighty-six is a number of Wednesdays, and fourteen is a difference between two public numbers; **none of the three is a number of people, none may be, and they have never been in one sentence and must not be — and nine hundred and eighty-six appears exactly once in Chapters 121–130, correctly labelled.** A priced-access case is not a recognition case. A node with no term in force is not a person with no address. A duty is an act and not a place. **A person who is not counted is not a person who is helped, and Volume 03 may not refute that sentence in a chapter.**

# VOLUME 03 OPEN THREADS — as they stand after Chapter 140, Wednesday 29 April 2015

**Read with the "VOLUME 03, BATCH 0004 — CHAPTERS 131–140" block at the end of `state/continuity.md`, which carries the canon. This file carries only what is still open and what it is forbidden to do. Volume 03 is OPEN and runs to Chapter 144. Chapters 141–144 are the volume close and have not been written.**

## 1. The counter, the shelf, and the drift

- **THE SHELF IS A DRAWER UNDER THE GROUND-FLOOR COUNTER WITH NO KEY ON IT AND NO LIST OF WHAT IS IN IT, ONE HAND, DATED, UNSIGNED, NO REFERENCE, NO BOX, NO NAME ON ANY OF IT INCLUDING NINA CALDER'S, AND IT IS GROWING.** There were nine on 9 March 2015 and there are more now and **nobody can say how many, which is correct, and Jonas Mercer has not counted it, has not looked at it, and is not going to, and she is not going to tell him.** A tenth slip went out on 16 March 2015 to a man of about sixty with a galvanised can, about the trough by the lock-ups, and it is in the inside of a coat. **There is no form in this borough on which anybody could write that they are not a series, and there is not going to be one, and a box that says *not a series* is a series.**
- **NINE SLIPS IS A COUNT OF DOCUMENTS. ABOUT ELEVEN PEOPLE A DAY IS A COUNT OF PEOPLE. THEY MAY NEVER BE ADDED TOGETHER.** A slip is only written when a person stands in front of her and asks what was true on a day. **A form that added the two would say *this counter sees eleven people and produces one document*, which is a level of service, and there is no level of service in that room.** No character in this batch knows either figure. **Jonas Mercer counted the people through the door ONCE, on 20 March, and stopped, and stopping is the finding and not a victory: a count of people through a door is a level of service the moment anybody can be held to it.**
- **THE DRIFT, AND IT IS NOW THE BATCH'S FINDING RATHER THAN ITS HYPOTHESIS. A STATE GIVEN ON A DAY IS A STATE ABOUT THE PERSON WHO GAVE IT.** A stale state belongs to a thing and a thing can be looked at; a contradicted state belongs to a person and a person cannot be looked at and cannot be asked, and the only way to move one is to ask the person, and asking a person is a service. **A STATE GIVEN ON A DAY STOPS BEING A STATE AND BECOMES AN OBJECT IN A COAT: it cannot be paid, cannot be returned, cannot be filed and cannot be destroyed, because there is no procedure on the sheet, so it goes in a pocket, and nobody comes back to argue it.** There is no obligation in this city to come back. **UNRESOLVED. Do not build an instrument for it. Do not write a form about it. The moment a form is written about any of this the volume has lost the thing it spent two volumes building.**
- **NOBODY CAME BACK TO ARGUE A STATE.** Abu Bakayoko's first slip, five nodes, 26 January, is seven weeks old in an inside pocket and has not been looked at since. He came on 2 and 13 February and has not come since. **If he comes on a Friday for another four years that is not a man, that is a rota with one name on it that nobody wrote down and that nobody could write down.** UNRESOLVED.
- **THE PEOPLE WHO COME IN ARE NOT THE PEOPLE WHO COME BACK, AND IT IS NOT A DEFECT, IT IS THE REASON THE ROOM WORKS.** A contradiction requires a second visit; a second visit is a decision; nobody in this borough is required to decide anything. **UNRESOLVED and it may not be argued out in Chapter 141–144.**
- **NINA CALDER IS PROVED RIGHT ABOUT THE SECOND HALF OF HER OWN SENTENCE, IN ADVANCE, AND DOES NOT KNOW.** On 10 April 2015 Jonas Mercer worked out that the shelf, not the bulb, is what will be held over somebody in about four years, and that she is going to be proved right about a register that grows when nobody is hurt, and **he is not going to tell her, and the reason he wrote down is that if he told her she would be the woman who was warned. UNRESOLVED and may not be resolved.**
- **THE FUTURE, STATED TWICE AND BINDING: a drawer of slips grows out of correct things done by careful people, nobody is hurt by it, and in about four years somebody is going to hand a piece of paper to a frightened person in a kitchen, and it is not going to have a bulb on it, it is going to have nine dates and one hand on it. A SLIP IN A DRAWER IS GOING TO BE EVIDENCE ONE DAY, HANDED OVER BY A PERSON WHO THINKS THEY ARE HELPING. And there is no version of that piece of paper in which the person it was written for is in it, and nobody is going to be able to say afterwards whether it was a service or a choice. UNRESOLVED.**
- **A COUNTER IS THE CHEAPEST PRIVACY DEVICE ANYBODY IN THIS CITY HAS BUILT AND IT COST NOTHING AND NOBODY DESIGNED IT. FINDABILITY IS WHAT A PRICE DOES WHEN THERE IS NO COUNTER IN FRONT OF IT. The man who turns the bucket at the board of forty slots at a bus turning head has been the most findable man in the lowland for twenty-six years and nobody did it, and Jonas Mercer refused out loud on 20 March not to go and find him, and the reason is THE FINDER IS THE HANDLE. UNRESOLVED. He is not on any list and has not been asked anything and will not be.**
- **THE PRICE OF FINDABILITY CAME BACK AT HIM IN HIS OWN PERSON ON 24 APRIL 2015, when a stranger asked the counter whether the man who stands at the wall is on a list, and the counter was right, and the answer cost four seconds, and he stood there for about nine minutes and said nothing and there was no point at which he could have said anything. IT DOES NOT PROTECT ANYBODY. IT ONLY MEANS NOBODY IS AIMING.**

- **AND THE THING NOBODY WAS TOLD, WHICH IS NOT A REPAIR AND NOT A RELIEF: A MAN OF ABOUT TWENTY-THREE WITH A BACK THAT HAS BEEN BAD SINCE THE SPRING, WHO CAME OUT ON THE EIGHTEENTH OF SEPTEMBER BECAUSE A HAND WENT ON HIM, IS NOT A MAN WHO HAS BEEN LET GO. HIS BACK IS IN NOBODY'S FIELD BECAUSE THERE IS NO FIELD. FIFTY-FOUR DAYS AFTER THE HAND WENT ON, NOBODY IN THIS CITY WAS TOLD THAT THIS IS WHAT HAPPENED, AND NOBODY COULD BE TOLD.** Jonas Mercer walked past him at about eleven o'clock on 11 November and did not stop.
- **THREE PEOPLE NOW KNOW THE MECHANISM AND NONE OF THEM IS GOING TO BE ASKED AGAIN: JONAS MERCER, NINA CALDER (the records supervisor, nineteen years, seven refusals, who wrote nothing down and made herself a cup of tea), AND TOMAS RENN, TOLD ON A BOAT ON 29 NOVEMBER, WHO SAID THAT IF HE SAID THE REST OF IT OUT LOUD IT WOULD BE IN JONAS'S MOUTH FOR THE REST OF HIS LIFE AND HE DID NOT SAY IT.**
- **THE SAINT ORRA WEST GATE AND ITS PERMITTED SENTENCE.** Jonas Mercer used it once, in 0205, unstaged, to Nina Calder, as the only thing he knows in this city that goes on by itself. A term is six days and is never called a week, the rota has not been rebuilt and cannot be, the 11:00–13:30 row is still empty and still does not say *vacant*, and Bram Osei's Thursday is still refused in his own handwriting with the second line in somebody else's hand and nobody looked at it.

## 2. What a lapse leaves, and the counter, and the gate-holder

- **ON 17 NOVEMBER 2015 JONAS MERCER WALKED THE BOROUGH FOR FIFTY MINUTES AND NOTHING HAD CHANGED.** The drawing is on the shutter at the top, the shutter at the bottom and the inside wall of the hall, the square in the middle of every one of them is still empty, and the gully outside the third door at the low end of Peverell Street is packed with silt because nobody came back with a bar.
- **A MAN OF ABOUT SEVENTY-THREE HELD A GATE OPEN FOR NINE HOURS ON 22 AUGUST, WAS PAID THE GOING RATE, HAS BEEN CALLED NINE TIMES SINCE, DECLINED NOTHING, AND ON 17 NOVEMBER WAS NOT CALLED AGAIN. HE SAID NOTHING ABOUT IT. WHAT JONAS MERCER NOTICED AND COULD NOT PUT IN A SENTENCE WAS THAT HE HAD HIS COAT OVER HIS ARM AND NOTHING IN HIS HANDS. NOBODY IS GOING TO ASK HIM AND HE IS NOT A MAN WHO HAS BEEN SET FREE.**
- **THE COUNTER WAS IN ONE SCENE AND ANSWERED NOTHING AND GAVE NO COUNT AND WAS NOT ASKED ABOUT ANYTHING.** A man of about twenty-eight came to it and asked whether there is anywhere a person can put the low end of Peverell Street. **THE ANSWER, TWICE, IN THE SAME WORDS, WAS *THERE'S NO FORM FOR THAT*, AND HE SAID *I KNOW*, AND THAT WAS THE WHOLE OF A FOUR-MINUTE MEETING.** He said one other thing, once, to the floor, about there having been no reason since the middle of September for anybody to be asked anything on any street in this city. He told nobody, including Jonas Mercer, who stood at the other end of the vestibule and said nothing. The drawer under the counter was not opened, not counted, not asked about, and the sentence in it is still in it.
- **THE EXACT MOTIF *THERE IS NO FORM IN THIS BOROUGH* IS AT ZERO IN ALL TEN CHAPTERS. THE SHORTER CONSTRUCTION IS IN 0206 TWICE AND IS THE COUNTER'S ANSWER, WHICH THE CARD ASKED FOR. THE ORDER AND THE IDEA OF A BOROUGH FORM ARE NOT PUT IN ONE SENTENCE IN ANY CHAPTER.**

## 3. The letter, and the boundary, and the crossing, and the thing nobody worked out

- **A ONE-PAGE LETTER CAME ON FRIDAY 20 NOVEMBER 2015 FROM THE STANDING GROUP OF THREE AUTHORITIES THAT RUNS THE WATER FOR THREE TOWNS IN RAVENSMERE, SIGNED BY ISELIN KROGH, ABOUT FIFTY-ONE, CLERK, NINETEEN YEARS IN THAT BUILDING, NOT THE PERSON WHO DECIDED IT. ITS FOURTH PARAGRAPH READS *WE RECORD YOU AS OUR CORRESPONDENT ON THE ABOVE*, WHICH IS NOT TRUE, AND HE REFUSED THE WORD IN WRITING ON THE SATURDAY ON A SHEET OF HIS OWN.**
- **THERE IS NO BUDGET, NOTHING TO BOOK A SEAT ON HERE AND NOWHERE ELSE, AND NOTHING IN THIS BOROUGH THAT CAN MAKE HIM BE IN A ROOM IN ANOTHER CITY. THE WHOLE OF WHAT THE GROUP HAS IS A MAN WHO HAS GONE.**
- **ON SUNDAY 22 NOVEMBER HE SAID, OUT LOUD, BEFORE ANYBODY HAD ASKED HIM ANYTHING, TO NELL ARDENT, THEN TO SANAA IQBAL, THEN TO TOMAS RENN: HE IS GOING AS A PERSON WHO IS THERE AND NOT AS ANYBODY'S DELEGATE, AND THE ARRANGEMENT HAS NO WORD FOR THAT. RENN'S ANSWER IS THE FINDING OF THAT SCENE: IT IS THE FIRST TIME ANYBODY HAS SAID THAT SENTENCE TO HIM BEFORE BEING ASKED, IN NINE MONTHS, AND EVERY TIME HE HAS BEEN ON THE OTHER SIDE OF IT HE HAS COST HIMSELF THE WHOLE EVENING GETTING IT RIGHT IN A CORRIDOR FIRST.**
- **FOUR PEOPLE CROSSED THE ESTUARY ON SUNDAY 29 NOVEMBER 2015 AT ABOUT TEN PAST SEVEN: JONAS MERCER, TOMAS RENN, NELL ARDENT, SANAA IQBAL. THEY HAD NOT BEEN IN A ROOM TOGETHER SINCE SEPTEMBER, WHEN TWO OF THEM ARGUED IN FRONT OF ABOUT THIRTY PEOPLE AND STOPPED AND NEITHER OF THEM DECIDED TO STOP. NOTHING WAS READ OUT. THERE WAS NO LIST AND NO ROLL AND NOBODY SAID ANYBODY'S NAME IN ORDER. THEY LANDED IN RAVENSMERE AT ABOUT TEN PAST EIGHT.**
- **SANAA IQBAL'S BOUNDARY, SAID IN A DOORWAY AT ABOUT HALF PAST SIX BEFORE THE BOAT: SHE IS NOT GOING TO BE FIXED, SHE IS NOT GOING TO BE THE REASON ANYBODY IS TALKED OUT OF ANYTHING OR TALKED IN TO ANYTHING, AND IF EITHER OF THOSE THINGS HAPPENS SHE WILL BE EXTREMELY UNPLEASANT ABOUT IT AND HE CAN PUT IT IN THE LETTER; AND SHE IS GOING BECAUSE THERE IS A BOAT AND FOUR OF THEM ARE ON IT AND A ROOM ON THE FRIDAY, AND SHE WOULD HAVE GOT IN IT IF THERE HAD BEEN THREE OF THEM AND IF THERE HAD BEEN FIVE, AND THERE IS NOT A SECOND REASON UNDERNEATH IT. **IT WAS NOT A QUARREL AND NONE OF THE FOUR IMPROVED IT AND NOTHING ABOUT THE TWO OF THEM WHO STOPPED IN SEPTEMBER IS REPAIRED.** HER TWENTY MINUTES A WEEK AND THE COMPLIANCE PARAGRAPH BEHIND IT ARE UNTOUCHED.
- **OPEN AND NOT ANSWERED: NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH HAS WORKED OUT HOW A STANDING GROUP OF THREE AUTHORITIES IN ANOTHER CITY HEARD OF A SHEET OF TWO PAGES THAT WENT DOWN ON A COUNTER BY THE WATER IN FRONT OF SIX PEOPLE ON 30 SEPTEMBER AND WENT BACK ACROSS THE ESTUARY IN A PLASTIC WALLET. NELL ARDENT WAS ALSO SENT A COPY BY SOMEBODY SHE COULD NOT IDENTIFY AND IS NOT GOING TO TRY. THE PERMISSION FROM ALDERWICK IS THE REASON THAT LETTER EXISTS AND IT IS NOT WORKED OUT, AND IT IS NOT A TWELFTH REFUSAL AND NOT A FINDING.**

## 4. The first regional system, and the two lines, and the bargain

- **THE FIRST OF THE THREE REGIONAL SYSTEMS WORKS, IS CHEAP, IS CORRECT, HAS NOT FAILED, AND EVERY PART OF IT IS HELD BY SOMEBODY PRIVATELY.** Ravensmere takes water off an intake, filters it and delivers it to three towns. The works was built before anybody in that room was born, the bill went down when the filters were done, the pressure at the far end of the third town is good enough that the clinic there has not had to ask for a tank in nine years, and a standpipe at the edge of the second town costs nothing and asks nothing. **IN THE FIRST TOWN THE WORKS IS A COMPANY'S, IN THE SECOND THE MAINS ARE A TRUST'S, IN THE THIRD ONE PUMPING STATION IS MUNICIPAL AND THE OTHER TWO ARE NOT, AND THE TWO THAT ARE NOT HAVE BOTH CHANGED HANDS INSIDE TEN YEARS, AND EVERY TIME ONE CHANGED HANDS NOTHING WAS BROKEN AND NOTHING WAS PROMISED AND THE OBLIGATIONS STAYED EXACTLY WHERE THEY WERE.**
- **NOBODY IN IT IS A VILLAIN AND NOBODY IS HIDING ANYTHING AND EVERY SENTENCE ISELIN KROGH SAYS IS RIGHT. SHE SAID THE WORD *DELIBERATE* OUT LOUD. SHE HANDED JONAS MERCER A COPY OF THE SHEET ON 4 DECEMBER, NO CHARGE, NO RECORD OF WHO TOOK ONE, AND HE IS THE ONLY PERSON WHO HAS ASKED FOR ONE IN THREE WEEKS. IT IS IN A PLASTIC WALLET IN HIS INSIDE COAT POCKET.**
- **THE SHEET, AT THE BOTTOM, IN THE SAME TYPE, THE SAME SIZE, WITH THE SAME SPACE ABOVE EACH: *Nothing is required of any person in order to use any part of this system.* AND *A person has no standing in respect of anything recorded under this.* A PERSON IS NOT REQUIRED TO GIVE ANYTHING UP TO USE IT AND A PERSON CANNOT DO ANYTHING ABOUT WHAT HAPPENS TO WHAT THEY HAVE GIVEN, AND BOTH ARE IN THE SAME TWO LINES, AND THERE IS NOTHING BETWEEN THEM. **THE CORRIDOR WALL SHEET CARRIES ONLY THE FIRST LINE AND HAS HAD A LINE TAKEN OFF IT AND HAS NOT BEEN LEFT BLANK. THE OFFICE SHEET CARRIES BOTH. BOTH CARRY THE DATE THE FILTERS WERE DONE IN A FOOTNOTE.**
- **A MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-ONE WHO COMES TO A CANTEEN HATCH AT TEN TO THREE ON FRIDAYS IN THIS CITY, AND IS ON NOTHING, PUT THOSE TWO FACTS NEXT TO EACH OTHER IN THAT CORRIDOR AND THEN WISHED HE HAD NOT: *I'D RATHER I HADN'T SAID THAT. NOT BECAUSE IT'S WRONG. BECAUSE I'VE JUST SAID THE ONLY THING ANYBODY'S SAID ABOUT THAT WALL IN ABOUT TEN YEARS AND I'M IN A CORRIDOR.* HE WENT BACK IN AND SAID NOTHING ELSE ALL MORNING. HE IS NOT A THREAD.**
- **THE GROUP SET THE STANDPIPE HOURS ON 15 DECEMBER TO SEVEN IN THE MORNING TO EIGHT IN THE EVENING, WHICH IS NOBODY'S NUMBER, AND THAT IS THE ONLY THING DECIDED IN THAT WEEK, AND IT IS IN A MINUTE IN A FILING ROOM IN RAVENSMERE AND IT IS NOT ABOUT ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH.**
- **AND THE SECOND PART OF THE SAME SYSTEM: A MAN OF ABOUT THIRTY-NINE IS THE LAST NAME ON THE SCHEDULE OF THE PERMISSION, WORKS FOUR DAYS A WEEK AT A PUMPING STATION IN THIS CITY ON THE DISTRIBUTION SIDE OF THE ESTUARY, IS PAID BY RAVENSMERE IN AN ENVELOPE AT RAVENSMERE'S RATE ON THE PAY DAY, AND CROSSES THE ESTUARY TO BE PAID. THE WATER UNDERTAKER HERE CALLS IT A RELIEF CONTRACT AND RAVENSMERE'S SHEET CALLS IT AN ATTACHMENT AND DEFINES AN ATTACHED MAN AS A MAN ATTACHED TO THE WORKS. HE IS THE ONLY PERSON IN THE WORLD WHO KNOWS THE DIFFERENCE. JONAS MERCER STOOD IN THE CORRIDOR, COULD HAVE ASKED HIM ONE QUESTION, AND DID NOT, AND IS NOT GOING TO. NOBODY IN THIS CITY COULD PRODUCE EITHER PIECE OF WRITING EVEN IF THEY WERE ASKED.** The group's own item on 9 December noted the number the arrangement had moved, which is six, and read out the sentence about where a claim arising out of the work is made.

## 5. The corridor, the sentence, and its standing

- **ON 15 DECEMBER 2015 ISELIN KROGH SAID THE TRUE THING ABOUT THE BARGAIN INTO A CORRIDOR, TO ONE PERSON, COULD NOT FINISH IT, SAID IT ANYWAY, AND THEN SAID SHE SHOULD NOT HAVE SAID IT, AND IT WAS NOT TAKEN BACK.** What she said: it is not a bargain between two things, it is an agreement that the part everybody is responsible for will always be the part somebody owns; the obligations were written first, the ownership came afterwards in pieces over a generation in rooms she was not in; nobody has had to do anything wrong for that to happen and nobody in that room has done anything wrong and every part fits and the water is good; **and the result of it, which nobody has ever put in a sentence in that room, is that the whole of the part of this that three towns are answerable for is the part that nobody owns, and the part nobody owns is the part that gets sold.**
- **She could not finish it because in that room the sentence is an accusation and it is not an accusation, and she said it because the man she said it to has no standing, no office, no department and no body behind him.**
- **JONAS MERCER SAID NOTHING AT ALL AND THE NOTEBOOK STAYED IN HIS INSIDE POCKET AND ON THE FRIDAY HE TOLD NELL ARDENT *NOTHING'S WRONG WITH IT. THE WATER'S GOOD*, AND IT STAYED IN THE CORRIDOR WHERE SHE PUT IT. NOBODY WAS GIVEN AUTHORITY AND NOBODY'S SENTENCE IMPROVED. THE STANDING OF THAT SENTENCE IS EXACTLY THE STANDING OF A SENTENCE SAID ONCE ON A PAVEMENT IN SEPTEMBER: SAID ONCE, NOT WRITTEN DOWN, NOT REPEATED, NOT MINUTED, AND CARRIED AS A THING THAT HAPPENED TO A PERSON.**

A woman of about sixty-nine was right about a timetable of the wrong year at a bus shelter and the four o'clock comes at ten to and the driver knows and does not say. **THEY WERE FOUR HUNDRED YARDS APART AND NEITHER KNEW ANYTHING ABOUT THE OTHER, AND THE ONLY PERSON WHO KNOWS BOTH OF THEM HAPPENED IS THE PERSON WHO WALKED DOWN THE SAME STREET TWICE. THIS IS THE THIRD TIME SINCE THE PUMP AT THE BOTTOM OF PEVERELL STREET THAT A CORRECT THING HAS BEEN DONE IN A STREET BY SOMEBODY WHO IS ON NOTHING AND NOTHING HAS COME OF IT.**

A receipt, because six people here took fourteen days across the estuary in October, were paid in an envelope before the work, all six came home on the dates on a sheet, one of the six has since had a claim made about him, and nothing here could tell those two things apart. A precedent, because if this borough answers it then it has agreed that the permission runs backwards as well as forwards, and if it does not answer it then a man of about twenty who worked a fortnight at a pumping station and came home has not got anybody.
- **JONAS MERCER WAS THE FIRST PERSON TO SEE WHAT IT WAS AND DID NOT SAY SO AND DID NOT GO AND FIND THE MAN OF ABOUT TWENTY, WHO WAS AT A FOOTBALL MATCH IN THIS CITY THAT AFTERNOON. THAT AFTERNOON HE TELEPHONED RAVENSMERE; ISELIN KROGH HAD HAD A LETTER WITH THE SAME REFERENCE ON IT SINCE THE EIGHTEENTH AND PUT IT IN A FOLDER IN A DRAWER; NEITHER OF THEM SAID WHAT EITHER OF THEM HAD; BY THE TIME SOMEBODY ELSE KNEW WHAT IT WAS THERE WERE TWO OF THEM IN TWO CITIES AND THERE IS NO DOCUMENT IN EITHER OF THOSE TWO CITIES THAT SAYS THAT EITHER OF THEM KNEW.** The man of about thirty-seven is not the man this is about and is not in one sentence, one list or one room with the man of about twenty or with Ewen Ashgrove, who appears nowhere in these ten chapters.

THAT IS ONE SYSTEM WITH A FRONT DOOR AND NO BACK, AND NOBODY IN EITHER CITY CAN SAY WHICH OF THE TWO THE PEOPLE WERE HANDED. IT IS OPEN.**

NOBODY WAS RESCUED AND NOBODY DIED. ## 1. The second regional system, and the five things, and the man

- **MARROWGATE IS A TOWN OF ABOUT THREE THOUSAND, EIGHT MILES UP THE ESTUARY PAST THE RAVENSMERE WORKS, AND EVERYTHING IN IT IS OWNED BY THE TOWN: THE WORKS, THE CLINIC, THE SHELTER, THE GATE AND THE YARD. A HOUSE THERE HAS A WATER BILL OF ABOUT NINETY PENCE A QUARTER AND NOBODY WHO LIVES THERE HAS EVER BEEN ASKED FOR A CARD. IT IS CHEAPER THAN THE FIRST SYSTEM AND BETTER AND IT HAS NOT FAILED, AND NOBODY IN IT IS A VILLAIN AND NOBODY IS HIDING ANYTHING.**
- **THE INVERSION IS EXACT: IN RAVENSMERE THE OWNERSHIP IS PRIVATE AND THE OBLIGATION IS PUBLIC AND THERE IS NOBODY TO HOLD IT; IN MARROWGATE THE OWNERSHIP IS PUBLIC AND THE OBLIGATION IS A PERSON. THE TOWN'S ARGUMENT IS THAT A DUTY IS AN ACT AND NOT A PLACE, AND A PLACE CANNOT BE GIVEN TO A PERSON, AND THEREFORE THE PERSON CANNOT BE REPLACED, AND THEREFORE NOBODY HAS EVER ASKED HIM. THE LAST LINK IS NEVER DRAWN OUT LOUD AND IT IS TRUE.**
- **THE ARRANGEMENT IS FOUR LINES ON A WALL AND NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH COULD PRODUCE IT EVEN IF THEY WERE ASKED. JONAS MERCER ASKED FOR A COPY ON 22 JANUARY AND REFUSED ONE HIMSELF: *I know exactly what happens to a piece of paper like that, and it would be a sheet somebody brought, and it is not the sheet on the wall.*** The clerk said right.
- **WALTER SALLOW, A MAN OF ABOUT EIGHTY-SIX, NAMED ON THAT SHEET, IS PAID AT THE GOING RATE AND HAS A HOUSE AT A SMALL RENT, IS NOT ON A ROTA, THERE IS NO LIST AND THERE IS NO JOB DESCRIPTION AND THE CLERK HAS TRIED TO WRITE ONE IN A SENTENCE ELEVEN TIMES AND CANNOT. HE WAS ASKED ONCE, IN A ROOM, IN A SPRING, SAID YES, WENT OUTSIDE, AND HAS NOT BEEN ASKED ANYTHING SINCE.**
- **HE IS THE ONLY PERSON IN THAT TOWN WHO COULD READ A PUMP HOUSE, STRIP A STOPCOCK, RELIGHT THE SHELTER BOILER, WORK THE INTAKE RACK AND CHANGE THE CHAIN ON THE YARD GATE — AND HE IS NOT THE ONLY PERSON WHO DOES ANY OF IT. HE FOUND THAT OUT BY THE WEDNESDAY AFTERNOON OF 12 JANUARY AND TOLD NOBODY.**
- **THE ONE PHYSICAL THING THAT COSTS SOMEBODY A DAY'S WORK AND THAT NO DOCUMENT IN THAT TOWN RECORDS: THERE IS NO TANK BIG ENOUGH, SO WHILE THE INTAKE IS SHUT THE WHOLE TOWN IS DRY, AND A WOMAN OF ABOUT EIGHTY WHO TAKES IN WASHING CANNOT START UNTIL THE WATER COMES BACK AT ABOUT EIGHT, AND HAS STOPPED WASHING ON THOSE TWO DAYS WITHOUT TELLING ANYBODY. THE TOWN'S HOSE HAS BEEN ON THE LORRY FOR YEARS AND NOBODY HAS COME FOR IT.**
- **HE WAS NOT RESCUED, HE WAS NOT ASKED TO STOP, NOTHING WAS ARRANGED FOR HIM, AND NOBODY IS GOING TO ASK HIM WHETHER HE WOULD LIKE TO STOP. HE IS NOT A THREAD.**

- **AND THE SENTENCE THAT SURVIVED IS THE BOROUGH'S OWN AND IT IS OLD AND IT IS NOT NEW AND IT IS NOT A TWELFTH REFUSAL: A DRAWING ON ABOUT FORTY WALLS, A PUMP IN A DOORWAY, A SHOVEL AND A BROOM, A LABEL ON A SHELF, A BENCH MOVED, A SIGN CHANGED, A HOSE NOBODY CAME FOR, AND A MAN OF ABOUT EIGHTY-SIX RAKING AN INTAKE BY HAND ARE ALL PEOPLE WHO WERE NOT ASKED AND NOT COUNTED, AND THE TOWN THAT OWNS THEM OWNS NOBODY, AND THE REGION THAT WILL SEND THE BILL OWNS NOBODY EITHER, AND THAT IS THE SAME SENTENCE TWICE AND IT IS STILL TRUE.**
- **ON 11 APRIL, IN A METHODIST HALL ON CARROW LANE, ALL SIX QUESTIONS WERE RESTATED IN ORDER AND NONE WAS ANSWERED, AND A MAN IN HIS SIXTIES PUT A VERSION ON THE TABLE THAT WOULD HAVE SETTLED THREE AT ONCE AND IT RESTS ON A DOCUMENT THAT CANNOT BE PRODUCED, AND HE SAID SO HIMSELF, IN FRONT OF NINE PEOPLE, AND SAT DOWN, AND HE NAMED THE TEMPTATION TO ADD A SEVENTH QUESTION AND LEFT IT ALONE. THE BATCH ASKED NO NEW ONE.**

# VOLUME 05 OPEN THREADS — after Batch 0005, Chapter 244, Saturday 4 June 2016

**Read with the "VOLUME 05, BATCH 0005 — CHAPTERS 235–244" block at the end of `state/continuity.md`, which carries the canon for these ten chapters and supersedes this block wherever the two differ, and with the "VOLUME 05, BATCH 0004 — CHAPTERS 225–234" block above it, which still governs everything those ten chapters did. **VOLUME 05 IS NOT CLOSED AND IS NOT DECLARED CLOSED. ## 1. What this borough is called first for, and why it cannot be put on a table

- **THE PRIORITY IS A PERSON AND A PLACE AND NEITHER CAN BE GIVEN TO ANYBODY.** It is a board about the size of a tea tray in a brick lock-up off a yard, with a strip of card tape and three cards cut with something that was not scissors: BOAT, ENGINE, LOW PEVERELL, and a gap under the third one where a name was.
- **THE MAN AT NUMBER FORTY-ONE IS ON NOTHING, PUT A PUMP IN HIS OWN DOORWAY IN THE WET WEEK OF THE NOVEMBER BEFORE LAST, AND TOOK HIS OWN NAME OFF THAT BOARD ABOUT THREE YEARS AGO BECAUSE *A NAME ON A BOARD IS A THING THAT GETS ASKED ABOUT, AND I'VE BEEN ON ENOUGH LISTS*. THE NAME IS IN A DRAWER IN HIS KITCHEN FOUR DOORS UP THE STREET. HE TOLD HEAR ABOUT IT BECAUSE A MAN IN A SHOP TOLD HIM.** He is the person the sacrifice in 0241 costs and he was not asked about it and was not asked to stop.
- **NELL ARDENT HELD BOTH HALVES AT ONCE, ON THE PAGE, STANDING IN FRONT OF THE BOARD:** a duty can be given to a man who is standing there, and you cannot hand a man to anybody either and you cannot hand a place to anybody. **THE SENTENCE *A DUTY IS AN ACT AND NOT A PLACE* IS NOWHERE IN CHAPTERS 235–244.**
- Jonas Mercer was in the car park and was not in the boathouse. His sum that day was five hundred and twelve.

## 2. The compact, and the four companies, and a right of return

- **A COMPACT CANNOT BE AGREED WITH A YARD, A RULE OR A BOOK. EVERY SENTENCE SAID ABOUT THAT AT PENHALE ON 26 APRIL WAS CORRECT.** A rule is not a party; a rule has not got a mouth; the yard cannot require anybody and therefore nobody in it can be told yes either.
- **A COMPACT IS AGREED WITH PEOPLE ONE AT A TIME AND EACH GIVES SOMETHING THAT IS THEIRS AND NOT SOMETHING A BODY OWNS.** Agreed so far: the woman of about forty-two with the key, with the hall, the notebook, the gas and no money, and a stated price of a Wednesday mothers' group and of becoming a woman running a thing; and a line that is not a claim in the carbon book at Penhale, which is worth nothing because a column is a column.
- **TOMAS RENN SAYS NO IN THREE CHAPTERS — 0236, 0237 AND 0238 — FOR ONE REASON, WHICH HE DOES NOT ADD TO AND WHICH HE IS RIGHT ON, AND NOBODY IN ANY OF THE THREE ROOMS ARGUES HIM OUT OF IT.** He has not said yes and may not be made to. A compact agreed with people one at a time is a list, and he knows what happens to lines.
- **THE FOUR COMPANIES WERE ASKED THE SAME QUESTION AND GAVE THE SAME ANSWER FOUR TIMES, ON SUNDAY 1 MAY: THEY WOULD SELL TO SOMEBODY ELSE.** Corrance Supply, from a room over a shop on a parade, with the rate on a board on a shelf behind her that she has never read. Sarn Aggregates, from a weighbridge: never turned a job away in twenty years, not one, not for a reason. Lowdale Hire, from a cabin, having already said the whole of it once in the February: *that's what a Tuesday is, and nobody sat down and made a Tuesday*. **Marchmont** (the fourth is Marchmont and not Marcement, because Chapter 0230 prints it twice and a chapter governs, and the state files that say Marcement are wrong on the spelling), from a card on a post by a gate, about a tenth above the yard: *nobody is coming here to be loyal to a borough; you want a supplier that's loyal, you want a family*. **NONE OF THE FOUR IS WITHHOLDING ANYTHING, BECAUSE NOT ONE OF THEM HAS EVER BEEN ASKED A QUESTION. A REGION CAN BE MADE TO GO SLOW BY A SUPPLY CHAIN THAT IS BEING POLITE, AND THE ONLY THINGS IT COSTS ARE A NOTEBOOK AND A WEEK ON A TUESDAY.**
- **A RIGHT OF RETURN IS A THING A PERSON MAY DO AND NOBODY IN THE BATCH SAYS THE SUMMATION.** The finding is arrived at by the woman of about fifty-five, who refuses Jonas Mercer's question — asking how many ways a person is allowed to do a thing is the same question about both and gets the same answer — and by rejecting three written drafts: a permission with a bad end on it, a rota, and a duty. **THE THING THAT MAKES A RETURN A RIGHT RATHER THAN A FAVOUR IS SOMEBODY BEING THERE WHEN IT IS NEEDED, AND THAT IS A THING TO BE ASKED FOR AND NOT A THING TO BE PROMISED IN ADVANCE. IT IS NOT A LANE ANYBODY LIVES IN, IT IS NOT A WAY OF MAKING A STREET FINDABLE, AND IT IS NOT IN ANY DOCUMENT, AND TWO PEOPLE REFUSED TO WRITE IT DOWN ON THE PAGE.**

## 3. What it cost him, the public part, and the sacrifice

- **ON WEDNESDAY 11 MAY JONAS MERCER SAID THE ASK OUT LOUD TWICE AND IT WAS THE WRONG MAN BOTH TIMES.** The ask is that this borough agree that if there is a regional emergency, its own crews go out of the borough before anything in the borough gets done. He is the man who has seen all three of the pieces of paper, and in about two years the version will be that the man who read the papers asked the borough to give up its first call. **He was not given his standing back and nobody told him it was borrowed, and he offered the other sentence and it was not true and he let it go past without slowing down for it.**
- **HE HANDED THE ASK TO MRS OBI, WHO IS ABOUT THIRTY-SIX AND IS THE SINGLE PERSON IN THIS BOROUGH WHO HAS EVER PUT TO ANOTHER IN A ROOM WHAT THEY WERE ASKING FOR, AND THEN WAITED.** She did not say no and she did not say yes, and she told him most of the borough would do exactly this and then wonder afterwards why nothing happened.
- **THE PRICE WAS THE NOTEBOOK, WHICH HAD BEEN IN HIS INSIDE POCKET SINCE THE SUMMER AND WAS THE ONLY THING HE HAD, AND IT IS NOT GIVEN BACK. AND FROM THAT AFTERNOON NOBODY IN THIS BOROUGH ASKED HIM ANYTHING AT ALL, AND HE FOUND OUT EVERYTHING ELSE BY STANDING IN A SHOP WHEN SOMEBODY SAID IT.** His sum on 11 May was five hundred and thirty-two.
- **ON SUNDAY 15 MAY, IN THE HALL OFF THE PARADE, ABOUT NINE PEOPLE LEARNED IN UNDER FOUR MINUTES THAT A COMPACT IS NOT A THING A ROOM CAN AGREE TO**, and that what a room can do instead is find out who would actually be bound by it, and that the answer is a list of people who have never been asked, longer than the room, which the room was not asked to produce and which the man in his sixties refused to produce and said should be made by the people on it, one at a time, over about six months, and by then it will be a different list. **His sum that day was five hundred and thirty-six and he was in the corridor and did not go in.**
- **ON FRIDAY 20 MAY, IN THE METHODIST HALL ON CARROW LANE, MRS OBI GAVE UP THIS BOROUGH'S FIRST CALL OUT LOUD IN A ROOM AND MEANT IT, AND IT IS A PRIORITY AND NOT THE INSTRUMENT.** The instrument is not in force, was not brought back to life to carry it, was not renewed, and no word of any document was altered and no name went in any line and nothing was written down. **The only reason it could be done is that nobody in either city can require anybody to do anything, and that is the first time in this account that the absence of a body has been any use and also the first time it has cost somebody something, and the card on that wall says both halves and neither was argued out of the other.** The man at number forty-one worked out that it is not the crews that have been lost and that nobody is coming down there now, and he said he would be there anyway, and he declined the key to the lock-up so that nobody would have the padlock to write his name in the gap with.

## 4. What came back, and the three weeks

- **THE PRICE DID NOT ARRIVE BECAUSE OF THE SACRIFICE AND DID NOT ARRIVE AFTER IT. IT ARRIVED ABOUT A WEEK BEFORE THE TWENTIETH, THE WAY A PRICE DOES, AND THE THREE WEEKS OF CREWS GOING OUT OF THE BOROUGH FIRST BEGIN AT THE BEGINNING OF MAY.** Hire, parts, fuel and insurance; twenty per cent on the one that matters; crews in the region that used to be ours and buy where they land.
- **A MAN WHO IS THE ONLY GOOD DRAIN MAN IN FOUR STREETS IS NO LONGER, AT NINE YEARS IN, AND HE SAYS IT IS A TUESDAY.** **A WOMAN IN MARSH LANE HAD A VAN EVERY TUESDAY FOR SIX WEEKS, HIRED OUT OF LOWDALE, AND THE TUESDAY WENT SOMEWHERE ELSE, AND THE SAME VAN OFF THE SAME FORECOURT WENT FROM A HUNDRED AND EIGHTEEN TO A HUNDRED AND THIRTY-SIX ON THE SAME HALF-MILE OF ROAD, AND THERE IS NOBODY IN THE WORLD SHE CAN RING ABOUT IT AND SHE HAS LOOKED.**
- **IT DID NOT LAST AND IT WAS NEVER GOING TO AND THE BATCH MAY NOT TURN IT INTO A TRIUMPH.** Her own prediction is that it comes back to about what it was by the middle of June, and that it happened both ways, and that the price is not a punishment and not a reward.
- **THE ONLY PERSON WHO PREDICTED IT IS JONAS MERCER, WHO SAID IT IN A CAR ON A PARADE ON 27 MARCH IN ABOUT NINE SECONDS, AND BEING RIGHT ABOUT IT HAS NEVER BOUGHT HIM A SINGLE THING IN THIS BOROUGH.**

## 5. The sheet of the eight towns, and the wider civic experiment

- **ON SUNDAY 29 MAY A SHEET OF A4 WAS LEFT FACE UP ON A BUS SHELTER BENCH BY A WOMAN WITH A PLASTIC WALLET OF SOMEBODY ELSE'S PAPERS, WHO SAID IT WAS NOT HERS AND GOT BACK ON THE BUS.** One line of printing across the top in about six inches of type, a column of places under it, no box, no name, no address, no reference, no date, nothing at the bottom, blank back.
- **THE LINE SAYS WORD FOR WORD WHAT THE FRAMED SHEET AT PENHALE SAYS.** Under it, eight towns: **Netherby, Tolforth, Halse Cross, Ansterwick, Kirkmoss, Ellersby, Marleby, Ockbrook.** The woman who has been in the Methodist hall on Carrow Lane about two years knows one of them, and Ockbrook's is on the way to her sister's, and she could not point at it.
- **IT MAY NOT BE SAID THAT IT CARRIES A CHARTER, A PROXY, A ROOT TERM, A HINGE, A SEAL, A DATE OF ORIGIN, A NAME OF A BODY, A MECHANISM OR AN EXPLANATION, AND IT DOES NOT, AND IT IS NOT A DOCUMENT ANYBODY IN THIS BOROUGH COULD ACT ON.** It is not lost, not mislaid, not stolen, and there is nobody to send it to.
- **THE WIDER CIVIC EXPERIMENT: THE ARRANGEMENT PENHALE RUNS ON WAS NOT THE FIRST OF ITS KIND AND WAS NOT THE ONLY ONE, AND IT IS REVEALED BY A LIST OF PLACE NAMES AND BY NOTHING ELSE.**
- **IT IS IN A DRAWER UNDER THE TRADE COUNTER AT THE BACK OF THE SHOP ON THE PARADE, FACE UP, ON TOP OF A DOCKET, UNDER A LOCK, AND HANNA WRAY HAS THE ONLY KEY AND HAS NEVER GIVEN IT TO ANYBODY. IT CAME OUT ONCE, ON 4 JUNE, ONTO A TABLE IN A METHODIST HALL, AND WENT BACK IN AT TEN PAST FIVE WITH THE LOCK TURNED TWICE. NOBODY HAS OPENED IT FURTHER THAN IT WAS OPENED.** That drawer is not the drawer in the vestibule and has a lock and an invoice spike in it.

## 6. The volume's own new question, asked once and not answered

- **ON SATURDAY 4 JUNE, AT ABOUT TEN TO FIVE, IN A METHODIST HALL ON CARROW LANE, THE MAN OF ABOUT EIGHTEEN WHO WASHES UP IN A KITCHEN AT THE BACK OF THE PARADE, FOUR NIGHTS AND A FRIDAY, ASKED IT IN PLAIN WORDS AND HE HAS NO STANDING TO ASK IT: *Somebody had to be first. Somebody wrote the first one. Somebody set it up and put the towns under it. Where are they now? What became of the first lot?***
- **NOBODY ANSWERED HIM. IT WAS NOT MINUTED. NOBODY ELSE IN THAT ROOM HAD A BOOK OUT.**
- **The shape of it is in the room and nobody put three of the things side by side.** Five words: a permission, an obligation, a claim, a compact, a right of return. Four of them can be pointed at. The fifth, a compact, cannot be pointed at anywhere in this borough or in any of those eight towns, and the reason is on a piece of paper on a table with eight towns on it and not one person's name on it anywhere.
- **THE THREE THINGS THAT EXPLAIN NOTHING: THE FIRST SYSTEM DID NOT EXPLAIN THE WOMAN IN THE CORRIDOR, THE SECOND DID NOT EXPLAIN THE MAN, AND THE SHARED YARD DID NOT EXPLAIN THE YEAR.**
